picks.excerpt: Figma introduces agent Skills — reusable workflow packages that let teams encode their design processes, conventions, and brand rules into the AI agent for repeatable tasks. Skills can be authored by anyone on the team, shared via the community, or pulled from official Figma packs.

Z.ai, the startup founded by former Zoom CEO Eric Yuan, has launched ZCode — an AI coding assistant targeting enterprise teams with deep codebase understanding and privacy-first architecture. ZCode positions itself as a challenger to Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code by promising faster iteration cycles and on-prem deployment options.

Anthropic is restoring global access to Claude Fable 5 — its most capable model — after the US Commerce Department withdrew the June 12 export-control restriction. Enterprises and design teams using Claude-powered workflows can now access Fable 5 across Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork starting July 1.
